# Establish the theme's visual system

Use the PRD, TRD and TDD to replace the starter's visual identity. Define a coherent set of CSS tokens and shared styles in `src/assets/css/theme.css`; coordinate any view or asset adjustments with the Razor implementation issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typography, colour, spacing, imagery and layout choices express the theme's intended identity across all page types.
- [ ] Light and dark modes retain readable contrast, visible focus states and a usable system-preference default.
- [ ] Responsive layouts work at mobile and desktop widths without hiding content or navigation.
- [ ] Styling stays framework-free and respects reduced-motion preferences.
